mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_dataset ( id, name, description, data_type, status, metadata, upload_time, update_time, is_valid, is_processed, progress ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{dataType}, #{status}, #{metadata}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TRUE, FALSE, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), data_type = VALUES(data_type), status = VALUES(status), metadata = VALUES(metadata), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE training_dataset SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, data_type as dataType, status, metadata, upload_time as uploadTime FROM training_dataset WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT data_type as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset GROUP BY data_type
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset GROUP BY status
SELECT uploaded_by as uploadedBy, COUNT(*) as count, 0 as size FROM training_dataset GROUP BY uploaded_by
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset WHERE upload_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(upload_time) ORDER BY DATE(upload_time) DESC LIMIT 7
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset WHERE upload_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(upload_time) ORDER BY DATE(upload_time) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT data_type as dataType, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_dataset), 1) as percentage FROM training_dataset GROUP BY data_type ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
